Information Technology and Projects Comm:
Key purpose and responsibilities
The Information Technology and Projects Committee was
responsible for ensuring the effectiveness and alignment of
ICT initiatives with the Group’s strategic objectives. Its key
responsibilities included:
• Evaluating major ICT projects to ensure compliance
with the ICT strategic plan and implementation
standards.
• Overseeing overall ICT performance and developing
strategies for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
• Aligning ICT initiatives with the Board-approved ICT
strategy to support business objectives.
• Conducting risk assessments to ensure ICT policies and
systems enhance long-term business sustainability and
stakeholder value.
Crisis Management and Business Continuit:
Key purpose and responsibilities
The Crisis Management and Business Continuity Committee
played a crucial role in safeguarding the Group’s resilience
against disruptions. Its key responsibilities included:
• Monitoring and overseeing business continuity
management and disaster recovery planning,
implementing corrective measures where deficiencies
were identified.
• Facilitating employee training and awareness programs
on business continuity strategies.
• Allocating resources, both human and financial, to
support business continuity initiatives.
• Managing risks arising from moderate or significant
disruptions by establishing robust frameworks to
enhance resilience and operational stability.
